items.title: Character voices: Voice.bin never opened
items.evidence: Hand-played runs (sys1804 04:22 "saud_0438", b1805 12:28) open Voice.bin right after spawn, then the main thread signals the IMS driver (cond 0x11E54CC0 by tid 1 at 0x208D0) which signals the At3 decoder (0x11E54F50 by tid 20): threads 18/19/20 ARE signalled there. Automated runs (walk/attack/talk probe 14:47, village runs) never open it. lr_diff.py: of 748 call sites tid 1 reaches in the working run, 729 are reached by every failing run and exactly 19 are not: all are lwmutex lock/unlock inside the Ksl IMS objects 0x11E54D18/0x11E54D60/0x11E54CC8 (func_000136E0, func_000140B4, func_0002116C, func_00013350). func_00013350 is called by func_005C69B0 <- func_005C73E4, a vtable thunk (no direct caller). Cause UNKNOWN: some game state/event decides to make that virtual call. Not an lwcond problem (same with SF_LWCOND 1 and 2). Probe presses (SQUARE/CROSS/CIRCLE/walk) in the village did not trigger it.
items.next: Needs a rebuild (approval): env-gated entry trace on func_005C73E4 / func_00013350 (print LR, r3..r6), then a run where Voice.bin opens vs one where it does not.
